main.description: Check whether a user should be authorized to read or write a space. Served by the space's managingApp rather than the PDS; called by the space authority with service auth at credential mint time (read) and at write-notification time (write).

space.description: Permissioned space URI, in the form at://{authority}/space/{spaceType}/{skey}. Not a standard at-uri.

did.description: The DID of the user requesting access.

access.description: The access kind being checked. Write checks carry no clientId, since write notifications do not identify the originating app.

clientId.description: The attested client_id of the requesting application, if a client attestation was presented. Reads only.

reason.description: Optional application-defined explanation for the decision.
